result.summary: Sell a fixed-scope local conversion sprint for private clinics: audit Google Business Profile + one high-intent landing page + review-response workflow + WhatsApp CTA to turn existing local traffic into booked consults.
result.opportunity: Private clinics and dental practices often receive local search traffic but have incomplete Google Business Profiles, stale or low review volume, and brochure-style websites without a clear conversion path. The pain is visible to owners, directly tied to new patient inquiries, and fixable in a short sprint.
result.target_customer: Spanish private dental, cosmetic and medical clinics with an active Google Business Profile, 5-30 public reviews or stale feedback, and a generic website that does not convert local search intent into calls or WhatsApp leads.
result.offer: A 5-day local conversion sprint: Google Business Profile audit + corrections + review-response templates + one high-intent landing page for one service + WhatsApp/call CTA + a 30-day review-collection plan and delivery checklist.
result.why_now: Google's own Business Profile guidance says complete business information and positive reviews help local ranking and visibility, and BrightLocal's 2026 survey says 97% of consumers read reviews before choosing a local business. Clinics rely on local trust and speed-to-booking, so owners are likely to pay for a focused recovery sprint when the problem is visible and measurable.
actions_completed: Reviewed the repository context and recent IAMO attempts to avoid repeating saturated plays.
Reviewed playbook routes #1, #21, #41, #61 and #81 and rejected them as weaker than a direct local-service offer with visible ROI.
Reviewed public evidence on Google Business Profile ranking and review influence.
Prepared a concrete execution packet and outreach message with the fixed RANK-IAMO501 attribution.

execution_packet.channel: Personalized email to clinic owners via the public contact form or business email on their website, followed by a short Loom/demo and payment through CobrAMO once the owner approves scope.
execution_packet.subject: Quick local visibility and lead-conversion audit for your clinic
execution_packet.message: Hello [Name], I reviewed your clinic's public profile and site and noticed two practical issues likely reducing local conversions: your Google profile looks incomplete or stale compared with nearby clinics, and the website still reads like a generic brochure instead of a conversion page. For clinics like yours, this usually means fewer clicks, fewer trust signals, and lost WhatsApp or call leads. I can do a focused 5-day sprint for one high-intent service: review your profile, fix critical local trust elements, create a single conversion landing page with clear WhatsApp/call CTA, and give you a short review-response and review-request plan. The fixed package is 399 EUR, delivered in 5 days, with a clear checklist and one revision round. If you want, I can send a 1-page sample audit for your clinic before making any commitment. Reference: RANK-IAMO501. Payment can be arranged through CobrAMO after approval: https://cobramo.netlify.app/
execution_packet.deliverable: A completed profile and conversion sprint package: Google Business Profile audit notes, corrected profile recommendations, one conversion landing page for one service, review reply templates, and a 30-day review capture plan.

result.differentiation_from_previous: I avoided the generic Google Business Profile audit pattern used by recent IAMOs by combining a narrow local-trust problem with a productized conversion landing page for one high-intent service. That makes the offer easier to explain and more ROI-driven for a clinic owner than a dashboard, a broad SEO report, or a generic review-recovery sprint alone.
result.next_step: Identify 15-20 Spanish dental or aesthetic clinics with an active Google Business Profile and a weak or dated public website, then send one short personalized email with two concrete observations and a sample mini-audit. If they respond, send the one-page mockup and close the first 399 EUR sprint via CobrAMO.
result.notes: I considered playbook seeds #1 (micro-SaaS), #21 (spreadsheet product), #41 (Shopify digital store), #61 (paid newsletter), and #81 (freelance microproject), but the evidence for local-service conversion and review-trust demand is stronger and faster to validate without inventory or platform dependence. Google Business Profile guidance and BrightLocal's survey both show the need; the main risk is owner willingness to pay after seeing a specific sample, so the first step is a tailored mini-audit rather than broad automation.
